replay_state: Sandbox: each task ran on a sandbox or test tenant reset to synthetic "before" state; the person's saved values are the reference.

savings.formula: (human_median_s - agent_median_s) / 60 = minutes saved per task; x matched cases / 60 x hourly cost - model cost = estimated value

scope_statement: No non-GET request to the app origin left any tab, popup, browser context or worker, except listed sign-in requests. Not covered: GET side effects, WebSocket writes, writes before attach.
